set.body:
Objective
Implement the five-stage known-item/new-participant item-effect court requested after GW-20.

Estimand boundary
This court asks whether an item's reinstatement propensity, estimated only from other participants viewing the same item, generalizes to a new participant. It is not the frozen item-disjoint retrieval estimand and cannot revise GW-18.10.

Acceptance criteria
1. Estimate cross-participant item propensity for Transport and all declared density comparators after training-only nuisance adjustment and shrinkage.
2. Quantify held-out participant score prediction and Transport-minus-density differences.
3. Estimate Transport-specific item propensity after training-only residualization against density sigma 80.
4. Test response-blind study repeated-viewing item propensity as a predictor of held-out retrieval Transport.
5. Test whether retrieval, Transport-specific, and study item propensities improve held-out 1-4 newness prediction for old and lure probes.
6. Enforce no self-participant leakage, report source counts and coverage, use crossed participant/item uncertainty, and retain trial-linked outputs locally.
7. Add analytic, metamorphic, adversarial, leakage-regression, and local-support tests; document all results and limitations.
set.title: GW-21 Cross-participant item reinstatement and newness court
